    Mailing list · unsubscribe

    Leave the list

    Stop receiving the Bablytics reports: enter the address you signed up with and it is removed at the next sync — or just reply STOP to any report.

    Two ways to stop the reports, both honoured before the next send. The quickest is to reply STOP to any report — Sean reads the replies. The other is the form below, which records the request in the same small database the sign-up page writes to; the app removes the address the next time the list is synced, which happens before every send. No reason needed, nothing else is kept, and nothing is sent to you in reply.

    Take me off the list#

    This copy of the page is not connected to the list's database — the Firebase project is not set up yet, or you are offline, or this is the single-file edition — so the button opens your own email app with the request prefilled and Sean removes you by hand. Nothing is sent until you press Send there.

    Your email app should now be open with the request prefilled — press Send and you are off the list. If nothing opened, use this link instead: email seaneven@gmail.com.

    Removal happens at the next sync, before the next send. If a report still arrives after a few days, reply STOP to it — that always works.

    Noted

    That address comes off the list at the next sync.

    The request is recorded; the app applies it the next time Sean syncs the list — his habit before a send, not something the app does on its own. If one more report slips through in the meantime, reply STOP to it. Changed your mind later? The sign-up page is always open.
